GitHub Certified: Agentic AI Business Professional (beta)

Overview

As a candidate for this certification, you are in business professional roles including, but not limited to, product manager, program manager, technical project manager, and business analyst.

  • Using GitHub productivity platform features
  • Enhancing productivity by using GitHub Copilot

Important

Learn more about the beta exam GH-700.

The GitHub Agentic AI Developer exam is currently in beta. As a result, you will not receive your results immediately. Scores will be released approximately eight weeks after the beta period concludes. Thank you for participating and helping us improve the certification!

This exam is provided by Microsoft, but the exam and associated certification are maintained by GitHub. Learn more about GitHub’s privacy policy.

Passing score: 700. Learn more about exam scores. Beta exams are not scored immediately because we’re gathering data on the quality of the questions and the exam. Learn more about beta certifications exams.

Take the exam

You will have 100 minutes to complete this assessment.
